title: Trump announces $8 billion Harvest Fuel Relief for farmers ahead of midterms
detail: At a Kansas rally on Oct 19, Trump announced an $8 billion Harvest Fuel Relief program to offset soaring diesel costs tied to the Iran war. USDA will reimburse a portion of losses using a formula based on acres and crops planted; payment rates are due in November. It follows the $12 billion Farmer Bridge Assistance package from December 2025, and arrives 15 days before the midterm elections as Republicans struggle in polls.

media.caption: Trump pledges $8 billion in relief for farmers facing high diesel prices
